name: Galerkin Transformer for PDE Operator Learning
summary: Learn PDE operators using a modified self-attention mechanism interpreted via projection in function spaces.
summary_zh: 通过修改注意力运算和归一化，将注意力层解释为函数空间中的投影近似。
core_idea: Design Fourier/Galerkin-type attention mechanisms suited to Hilbert-space operator approximation.
innovation: Addresses the efficiency and interpretation limitations of standard softmax attention in operator learning.
limitations: Attention models still require representative operator training data.
Formal projection interpretations rely on mathematical assumptions.

start_here.why: NeurIPS method paper, especially relevant to operator architecture alternatives.

curation_note: Representative publication checked; recommendations are advisory and application-specific clinical claims require separate evidence.
